api_source.note: Working candidate identified by content hashes; commit recorded after validation.

sampling.small_cases: Three fresh SQLite databases per 0/1/40 and history-10/100 dataset.
sampling.large_normal: Five fresh local databases with 501 dirty rows; shared seeded server replay state and one Flutter desktop process.
sampling.large_failure: One functional 500+1 recovery trial; not a latency population estimate.
sampling.rationale: Large pilot cases previously took about 100 seconds. Five normal repetitions expose variability within bounded cost; the additional fault case proves recovery. Five is also the minimum n giving a one-sided >=95% order-statistic bound on the population median under IID assumptions (1-2^-5=96.875%). These temporal/shared-server observations do not establish those assumptions, so bounds are explicitly conditional, not certified coverage.
sampling.json_microbenchmark: Per actual pull body: 20 warmups plus 100 batches of 10 UTF8/jsonDecode calls after the sync timer stops. Batches are correlated microbenchmarks, not independent HTTP samples.

coverage: 0/1/40/501 dirty rows, empty pull and actual multipage pull
Growing server histories 10/100; final cursor compared with persisted max revision
Five large normal trials retain exact IDs/names, zero dirty rows and original file bytes
Injected second push 503 after the first 500 commit: retry restores all 501 without loss/duplicate
JSON primitives measured separately from actual production replaceCatFromSync application
HTTP request/response sizes, operation limit, client cycle and resource observations retained

finding.description: On this Windows SQLite FFI fixture, the 501-row cycle median is 93.701 seconds and median time in production replaceCatFromSync totals 68.422 seconds. Application/database work is a measured optimization candidate.
finding.recommendation: Profile transaction/statement boundaries before proposing batching; preserve queue/cursor/reference atomicity and revalidate existing mutation oracles.

limitations: Desktop Flutter JIT/SQLite FFI plus real loopback API/PostgreSQL; no phone or release-rendering inference.
Cycle timing includes the fixture integrity readback; model mapping and other SQL/file work outside replaceCatFromSync remain in residual time.
RSS is the test process observation, captured before decode profiling; it is not product-only peak memory.
Empirical P95 values from small/heterogeneous HTTP samples describe this run only; no reliable P99 or definitive speedup claimed.
Conditional median bounds assume IID/stationarity, not proved by serial shared-server trials. Future optimization comparisons require paired independent blocks.
The assert-rewrite warning was formatting of pytest diagnostics, not skipped assertions; registration was corrected for future runs without repeating this expensive green campaign.
